840	What have you got until now? Don't you see that HaShem
841	brought you this as a gift? What are you getting so excited about?
842	What... "Wow, how I understood!" Say thank you to HaShem.
843	Where did you go? Where did you go? A person does something
844	with money, succeeds in some business, and feels: "Ah, how
845	I made this deal! What a... what a
846	talent I am!" Just a moment, Adonai,
847	do not forget. One can quietly go down to the lowest depths even
848	through the good, especially when a person gets carried away with his own power, and so
849	he does above his level: "It's all me, it's all
850	my talent, all my strengths."
851	What a pity, this is...
852	Right, right.
853	But what does that do to a person who is good, for whom everything seems
854	fine? Not to get confused there.
855	So for this Rabbi Natan says: for this reason we
856	go through all the ups and downs.
857	And our work is the work we received from Avraham
858	Avinu: to believe,
859	to believe that both the downs and the ups are all
860	from HaShem, for your good. Remember HaShem, remember HaShem,
861	says Rabbi Natan, for only for this was man created
862	and sent down to this physical world, full of husks and darkness,
863	so that he can bring out the very, very hidden kindnesses
864	from concealment into revelation.
865	This is the essence of the greatness of the Creator, may He be blessed: the essence of the greatness
866	of the Creator is that a person in this world reveals the great
867	mercies. Where?
868	In light and in darkness,
869	in tsedakah
870	and in mishpat, that he reveals the mercies,
871	that he reveals the hidden mercies.
872	And this is the main purpose of the descent, for the sake of the ascent. For through
873	the descent...
874	and nevertheless he strengthens himself. Here is the advice: he strengthens
875	himself through faith
876	in His boundless and endless kindnesses, may He be blessed. Through
877	this he reveals His kindnesses, he brings the hidden kindness
878	from concealment into revelation. And this is what is written about Avraham: "For
879	I have known him,
880	so that he will command his children and his household after him,
881	and they will keep the way of HaShem, to do tsedakah and mishpat."
882	For it is the way of HaShem, that surely one must do tsedakah and mishpat,
883	that is, that within the mishpat
884	one does tsedakah, and within the tsedakah one does mishpat. How can one
885	understand this? It's confusing. You say, wait, I
886	don't understand. There is nothing to understand here. Believe. Take this
887	from the start
888	as an axiom, a basic premise: everything is for your good.
889	The good is for your good. And if the good is withheld from you, it is
890	for your good. And if you have some difficulty, it is for your good.
891	In our relationship with HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
892	what we say in front of... If I am now
893	with my daughter and my wife, a friend, am I also supposed to call
894	everything mishpat? Like what I am saying now?
895	Check. But you want to say something that is mishpat.
896	Yes. The answer is yes, but that is in itself
897	a separate matter,
898	because here we are talking about
899	believing
900	that everything comes from love, and that is how HaShem runs the world
901	with opposite attributes. This is actually the teaching of Avraham, tsedakah within mishpat.
902	This is the teaching of Avraham, and there is another derived
903	point that I did not want to expand on, but it is definitely laid out
904	here: it is also the way we must behave
905	with those close to us, with our wife, with our children.
906	So it is the Sages, or anyone I influence:
907	"Let the left hand always push away and the right hand draw near."
908	Tsedakah and mishpat is also a way of conducting life with whoever
909	is in front of me. If I only do favors for whoever is in front of me,
910	he spits on me. He belittles me. He
911	does not appreciate anything, and in the end he becomes the poorest, because
912	he does not enjoy anything, because he does not know how
913	to appreciate anything. When we give to children, or
914	to people I work with, or anything like that,
915	we set boundaries and say "no," and we state
916	the din. There are rules, not everything is deserved. So
917	when he receives, he knows how to appreciate, and then he enjoys
918	and merits a good life. And of course, if you only say "no,"
919	you have strangled the person.
920	So, you are absolutely right, this too is the way
921	of conduct.
922	And a lot is needed here. HaKadosh Baruch Hu knows
923	how to combine this, but with people, once
924	again, if I only give, they don't know how to appreciate.
925	If I only close off and withhold, they think
926	I am against them. This too requires a great deal of siyata
927	diShmaya. Let's see once more, further on.
928	About this Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, asked: "Make me know
929	Your ways."
930	Moshe Rabbeinu says to HaShem: I don't understand how You
931	run the world. It's confusing, because You have
932	opposite attributes.
933	He asked to know the ways of HaShem, His judgments and His tsedakah.
934	He wants to understand the din in depth, I want to understand
935	the chesed in depth, and I want to understand the combination.
936	Who can understand this?
937	He wanted to grasp
938	how HaKadosh Baruch Hu runs His world with tsedakah
939	and mishpat, so that he would know how to pray for Israel.
940	And HaShem, may He be blessed, answered him and said: "I will cause
941	all My goodness to pass before you."
942	And He revealed to him all 13 Attributes of Mercy.
943	And this is the level of "and they will keep the way of HaShem, to do
944	tsedakah and mishpat," for keeping tsedakah and mishpat is
945	surely the way of HaShem.
946	And again, in a person's daily life,
947	there is the point of how I look at everything: everything
948	good is from HaShem, thank You so much, I appreciate
949	it, I treasure it, I draw close to You, I
950	thank You, I am moved by You, because You give me
951	everything. And the bad, Heaven forbid, You know what You are doing,
952	it is for my good, it is because of love, not because of
953	hatred. You are not pushing me away, You are cleansing
954	me, and it is because You love me. And with traits
955	and attributes too I act in the world.
956	A moment comes when I say: fine, there's no need to make such an effort,
957	so much.
958	No need to advance, because after all, as we said with
959	Yishmael, everything is good. Remember that there is din, keep going.
